High Jump.—1, Ford (S.); 2, Gowans (S.); 3, Sternheim (N.); Height 5ft. 8in. Long Jump.—1 Rugman (N.); 2, Vanhegan (N.); 3, Quarton (S.); Dist. 21ft. ½-in. Medley Relay.—1, North of Thames; 2, South of Thames.

Charlie Melchior won the Javelin with a throw of 153 feet, and young Higgins gained third place in this event as he also did in the Discus. Rugman, of Shaftesbury, won the Long Jump, with Quarton taking second place to finish off a busy afternoon's work as had the Met.
